title: GaiaBalance
description: A realistic karma system where your actions impact nature—gain druidic powers through restoration or face environmental blight and curses for destruction.
body:
# 🌿 GaiaBalance
Restore the Earth. Master the Elements. Maintain the Balance.
GaiaBalance is a realistic environmental karma system for Paper-based Minecraft servers. Every action you take—from planting a single sapling to burning down a forest—is tracked by the spirit of nature. Will you become a blessed Druid of the forest, or face the decaying wrath of the Blight?

## 📊 The Karma System
Your relationship with nature is measured on a scale from 0% to 100%. Check your action bar at any time to see your current standing.

- 🌱 Restoration: Gain Karma by planting saplings, breeding animals, and living off a sustainable vegetarian diet.
- 🔥 Destruction: Lose Karma by clear-cutting forests, industrial furnace use, killing passive fauna, or using fire.

## ✨ Features of the Blessed (High Karma >80%)
When you protect the world, the world protects you.

- 🌸 Green Thumb: Nature blooms in your footsteps. Grass and flowers may sprout as you walk.
- 🐾 Animal Magnetism: Passive animals feel your gentle spirit and are naturally drawn toward you.
- 🌾 Abundant Harvest: Nature rewards your care with increased crop yields during harvest.
- ☁️ Part the Clouds: Look at the sky and sneak-click the air to instantly clear storms (Costs 40% Karma).

## 🥀 Omens of the Blighted (Low Karma <30%)
Betray nature, and it will turn against you.

- 🌵 Nature's Thorns: Vegetation becomes sharp and hostile; walking through brush will damage you.
- 🐝 Hostile Fauna: Normally peaceful creatures like Wolves, Bees, and Llamas will attack on sight.
- 💀 The Blight (<10%): The environment rots around you. Grass turns to coarse dirt, and flowers wither into Wither Roses in your presence.
- ⚡ Nature's Wrath: Face sudden lightning strikes, poison, or permanent rejection (Spectator mode) if your Karma hits zero.

## 🪄 The Druid's Staff
- At 90%+ Karma, you can wield the legendary Druid's Staff (Crafted with an Emerald and Sticks).
- 
- Left-Click: Channel life energy to instantly grow plants (Bonemeal effect).
- Right-Click: Summon a temporary Shield of Leaves to block your enemies.
